newsitem.title: USA: Milton Federal ups qtly div, sets special.
newsitem.headline: Milton Federal ups qtly div, sets special.

text.p: Milton Federal Financial Corp on Thursday set a special dividend of $2.50 per share to all shareholders of record on November 4.
Additionally the company increased its quarterly dividend from $0.13 per share to $0.14 per share for shareholders of record November 4.
Both the quarterly dividend and the special dividend will be paid November 15, the company said.
Today Milton reported a fourth quarter loss of $0.05 per share on net loss of $122,291, after a one-time assessment for recapitalizing the Savings Association Insurance Fund.
The company reported a $0.19 profit for the year-ago quarter.
